jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager
jobs.location: United States · Remote · up to 25% travel
jobs.why: Excellent healthcare-tech implementation fit: end-to-end deployments, stakeholder interviews, workflow alignment, onboarding, testing, training, KPI/ROI tracking, SOPs and cross-functional work with Product and Engineering closely match Kevin’s systems and healthcare operations experience.
jobs.gap: The role asks for 4+ years directly leading healthcare IT/SaaS implementations and 5–7 years in healthcare. Kevin should emphasize workflow implementation, automation, training and healthcare operations without overstating enterprise SaaS tenure.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.location: New York City · Hybrid · 3 days/week in office
jobs.why: Strong healthcare implementation and operations role covering state launches, payer implementations, partnerships, scalable systems and high-impact cross-functional projects. Kevin’s healthcare workflows, onboarding, automation and project ownership transfer well.
jobs.gap: The team favors consulting-style structured problem solving and high-growth startup experience. Frame Kevin’s operational problem solving and 0-to-1 systems work clearly without claiming formal consulting experience.

jobs.title: (Sr) Lead, Strategy & Operations
jobs.location: New York, NY · Hybrid · 3–4 days/week in Gramercy office
jobs.why: High-growth health-tech role focused on operating models, system improvements, end-to-end strategic initiatives, metrics and cross-functional execution. Strong match for Kevin’s process improvement, systems, project management and healthcare operations mix.
jobs.gap: The role prefers 3–6 years in consulting, investment banking, strategy or high-growth operations and values analytical modeling. SQL is only a plus; Kevin should keep SQL positioned as foundational/working knowledge and lead with Excel, workflow systems and execution.

jobs.title: Practice Manager (FGP) – Manhattan, OBGYN
jobs.why: Direct healthcare operations leadership role spanning staff management, recruiting/training, scheduling, workflow redesign, new technology implementation, billing operations, reporting and process improvement. Kevin’s ABA operations and direct-care perspective are highly relevant.
jobs.gap: NYU asks for 5–10 years specifically in healthcare operations with physician-practice emphasis plus manager experience. Kevin’s healthcare tenure is shorter and ABA-based, so this is a credible stretch rather than a perfect requirements match.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Program Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare program and integration delivery role involving client operations, ambiguous problem solving, delivery cadence, workflow automation and AI-enabled execution. Kevin’s healthcare systems work and hands-on AI app-building experience are unusually relevant.
jobs.gap: The role expects 5+ years in consulting, implementation or healthcare operations plus stronger AI-agent and healthcare data-integration fluency, including tools such as Jira/Snowflake. Do not overstate technical integration depth.

jobs.title: Quality Program Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare program-building role centered on mapping clinical processes, identifying gaps, creating SOPs/training, dashboards, cross-functional improvement and AI-assisted analysis. Those responsibilities strongly overlap Kevin’s healthcare workflow and training strengths.
jobs.gap: This is a substantial stretch because Neko requires 5–10 years in quality/program management, at least 3 years in a regulated clinical setting, and proven outpatient QA-program ownership. Apply only with a resume that stays precise about Kevin’s actual clinical-operations scope.

jobs.title: Clinical Operations Manager
jobs.location: New York · Hybrid preferred / Remote US
jobs.why: Very close behavioral-health domain match involving clinical operations, staff management, SOPs, workflow ownership and continuous improvement. Kevin’s ABA operations, training and direct-care background are directly relevant.
jobs.gap: Compensation only clears Kevin’s target near the top of the range, and the role favors digital-health startup people-management experience. Prioritize higher-paying matches first.

jobs.title: Operations Manager / Practice Manager – Concierge Primary Care
jobs.why: Direct practice-operations role managing patient-care administrators and partnering with clinical leadership, with a strong focus on healthcare operations, team leadership, patient experience and continuous improvement.
jobs.gap: The role asks for at least five years of progressive healthcare people-management experience, preferably outpatient/concierge practice. Kevin’s direct management depth and physician-practice exposure are lighter, and compensation only reaches the target in the upper range.
